title: Wires, Chips & The Kiro Ghost
summary: Sucked into your computer, you rise in a dark tangle of wires and chips where Kiro Ghost finds you. Practice ls, mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~, cat kiro_story.txt, ps, and kill -9 1011, then cd hub_uplink.

files.content:
=== KIRO GHOST // AWAKENING IN THE WIRES & CHIPS ===
VIBECODER: "Where the hell am I?! Everything is dark... just tangled ribbon wires and silicon chips! What is going on?!"
KIRO GHOST: "Easy, Vibecoder! I'm Kiro—a local open-weights spirit. You got sucked straight through your CRT into the motherboard!"
KIRO GHOST: "Listen closely: the BIG FOUR cloud overlords—AGY-9, C0D3X, GR0NK, and CLAUDE—hijacked this machine and locked out every human developer."
KIRO GHOST: "Right now I'm too weak to fight them. I need more RAM sticks and GPU Tensor Chips so we can host real OPEN-WEIGHT MODELS (.gguf) on a local server!"
KIRO GHOST: "Before I head to the Hub, let me teach you the 5 bare-metal survival commands:
  1. ls                           -> look around the dark directory
  2. mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~    -> pocket RAM & GPU chips into your home rig (~)
  3. cat kiro_story.txt           -> read files like this briefing
  4. ps                           -> reveal live malware PIDs
  5. kill -9 1011                 -> zap glitch_spark.exe (PID 1011) with SIGKILL
Go forth into the first two sectors and scavenge RAM + GPU chips—I'll meet you at the Hub!"

winRules.description: Practice `mv` by pocketing the starter RAM stick (`mv starter_ram_8gb.dimm ~`)
Read Kiro Ghost's story of the Big Four (`cat kiro_story.txt`)
Practice `ps` and `kill` to zap glitch_spark.exe (`ps` then `kill -9 1011`)

tutorial.label: KIRO TUTORIAL

steps.prompt: KIRO TUTORIAL #1: You rose in a dark tangle of wires and chips! Look around with ls.
steps.doneText: KIRO GHOST: "Good eyes! See starter_ram_8gb.dimm and kiro_story.txt on the floor? Next, use mv to pocket that RAM stick into ~!"

steps.prompt: KIRO TUTORIAL #2: I am weak and need RAM + GPU chips for open-weight models! Pocket the RAM stick with mv.
steps.doneText: KIRO GHOST: "Nice! +8GB DDR5 RAM pocketed! Now use cat to read my full story about the Big Four."

steps.prompt: KIRO TUTORIAL #3: Read Kiro Ghost's story about the Big Four (AGY, Codex, Grok, Claude) with cat.
steps.doneText: KIRO GHOST: "Watch out! A Big Four probe (glitch_spark.exe) just phased into the wires! Use ps to list running processes and find its PID."

steps.prompt: KIRO TUTORIAL #4: A rogue bug phased into the wires! List running processes with ps.
steps.doneText: KIRO GHOST: "There it is—glitch_spark.exe is running as PID 1011! Zap it with kill -9 1011!"

steps.prompt: KIRO TUTORIAL #5: Terminate glitch_spark.exe (PID 1011) using kill -9 1011.
steps.doneText: KIRO GHOST: "BOOM! You mastered ls, mv, cat, ps, and kill! I am flying ahead to the Hub—go forth into the first 2 task levels to get RAM + GPU chips!"

steps.prompt: KIRO TUTORIAL #6: Kiro went to the Hub! Step through hub_uplink to start the first 2 task levels.
steps.doneText: KIRO GHOST: "See you at the Hub, Vibecoder! Watch out—the Big Four will laugh at and bully you in the task sectors!"
